name: EpiHiper
description: High-performance parallel epidemic simulator supporting large-scale agent-based modeling of infectious disease spread. Open-source under MIT license; uses census-based synthetic populations and validated contact network data. Designed to scale across HPC clusters for simulating national-scale epidemics with detailed intervention modeling including testing, contact tracing, vaccination, and non-pharmaceutical interventions. Published in PNAS Nexus.
general_score_metric: simulation throughput and scalability (e.g., simulated agents per second and strong/weak scaling efficiency); epidemiological fit metrics (e.g., RMSE between simulated and observed incidence curves) are also used
reputation: State-of-the-art open-source HPC epidemic ABM; published in PNAS Nexus; used for COVID-19 policy analysis
notes: Open source (MIT license) on GitHub. Successor to EpiSimdemics; optimized for modern HPC architectures. Supports heterogeneous agent attributes, dynamic contact networks, and complex intervention scenarios.
